integrity: Every binary word through length 7 is exhaustively checked. Two independent constructions of each theta-conjugate set are required to agree: the standard cut formula and a direct search of the defining equation. No finite result is extrapolated to the unresolved general maximum.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the binary Watson-Crick involution and determines only the shortest attainment of three ordinary palindromes in a theta-conjugate set. It does not prove the source's conjectured general upper bound of three. An unindexed computation or unpublished note could contain the same finite classification.
title: Shortest binary Watson-Crick conjugate set attaining three palindromes
